sources.entry: MongooseIM - Mobile messaging platform with a focus on performance and scalability. (Source Code) GPL-2.0 Erlang/Docker/K8S

summary.one_liner: MongooseIM is a scalable, fault-tolerant XMPP server (Erlang) aimed at large instant messaging installations, maintained by Erlang Solutions.
summary.what_it_does: The README describes MongooseIM as an XMPP server for large Instant Messaging platforms that can run across multiple clustered machines and scale by adding nodes. It accepts client sessions over vanilla XMPP, a REST API and SSE, as well as WebSockets and BOSH (HTTP long-polling). The project is presented as a platform that also includes server-side and client-side components, a test suite, metrics, a load testing platform, and a monitoring server. Packages are offered as a Docker image, a Helm chart, and pre-built packages for Ubuntu, Debian, and CentOS-compatible systems (AlmaLinux, Rocky Linux). The README also links to a GraphQL API with separate user and admin schemas, and to versioned documentation covering releases from 3.0.1 to 6.10.0 and master.
use_cases: run a large-scale XMPP chat server
add instant messaging to a mobile or web app
XMPP server with REST or GraphQL APIs
deploy chat server on Docker or Kubernetes
how_to_run: Download the Docker image, Helm chart, or pre-built package for your platform (listed in the README)
Follow the 'Getting started' guide linked from the README
See the documentation for build-from-source tutorial
notable: Accepts XMPP, REST API, SSE, WebSocket and BOSH client connections in one server
Clustered design that scales by adding machines
Ships with a test suite, metrics, load testing platform and monitoring server
Documentation covers many releases from 3.0.1 up to 6.10.0 and master
caveats: README does not state specific platform limits or hardware requirements
Client libraries are third-party; the README only recommends them
